name: Ayagaures Loop
description: The steady local climb from the southern resorts into the Ayagaures valley — 34 km with one beautifully graded ascent, ideal for a first ride or structured efforts.

name: Fataga and Santa Lucía Loop
description: The most photographed road on the island: up through the Fataga ravine's switchbacks to San Bartolomé and back via Santa Lucía. 70 km of classic Gran Canaria.

name: Puerto de Mogán Loop
description: West along the coast to Puerto de Mogán and up the Barranco de Mogán — 80 km of rolling coast road and a steady valley climb.

name: Soria and Veneguera Loop
description: Into the island's wild west: the long Soria valley climb to the reservoir, over to Veneguera and back along the coast. 87 km with 1,800 m of climbing.

name: Cruz Grande and Pico de las Nieves Loop
description: The mountain classic: up the Degollada de Cruz Grande to Pico de las Nieves, the island's roof at 1,920 m. 76 km, over 2,000 m of climbing, views over the cloud sea to Teide.

name: Pico de las Nieves Big Day
description: The full island summit day from the south: 114 km and nearly 2,800 m, taking in Fataga, the high centre and the long run back down. Gran Canaria's benchmark big ride.

name: Playa de Mogán and San Nicolás Viewpoint
description: 90 km along the dramatic west: Playa de Mogán, the cliff road towards San Nicolás and 2,000 m of climbing on the island's wildest tarmac.
